behavior: Failed signing, policy lookup or durable write leaves prior active credential/revision unchanged.
Verification uses stored canonical v2 bytes and stored signature; optional caller bytes must match; current active pointer and real registry identity checked.
Signature binds issuance identity/revision, signer identity, issuer/reason, all scope fields, times and policy.
Durable mode persists Ed25519 key plus single-writer atomic state; rejects corruption and ambiguous commit until restart.
Both active UUID and monotonic aggregate revision CAS required on durable mutations; empty-state ABA and stale cross-field combinations rejected.
Canonical signed bytes exposed in binary metadata; historical issuance revision is distinct from current aggregate revision.
Mutation token required in durable runnable mode; shared advisory fence taken before service mutex; reads do not acquire fence.
whole_milestone_status: Not assessed by this component report; real connected acceptance and deployment recovery remain root-owned.
limitations: Single host cooperating advisory-lock guarantee, not distributed fencing or consensus.
Privileged state/key rollback is outside local persistence guarantee.
No TLS/workload identity provisioning or implicit policy authorization in passport issuance; explicit upstream policy identity/version is captured.
Lifecycle ledger delivery is performed by integration owner; durable mode does not use a fake ledger.
Legacy demo memory mode remains available and uses test signing/identity; it is excluded from real-service acceptance.
